landing-06-hero-eyebrow: For teams publishing across more than one brand
landing-06-hero-title-elaboration: One calendar, one composer, one approval trail.
landing-06-hero-description: Plan, adapt and approve content for every client profile from a single timeline — with per-action permissions so nobody publishes on a brand they were not given.
landing-06-hero-beta-note: PublyApp is in open beta and free to use today. Billing and a free trial are planned before general availability.
landing-06-hero-image-alt: Weekly calendar view across four brand profiles, with real posts and author avatars
landing-06-strip-calendar-body: Planned and queued content for every profile and region in a single view.
landing-06-strip-composer-body: Reuse copy and assets across profiles, then change only what a channel needs.
landing-06-strip-approvals-body: Approval and publish rights are explicit at every step of a post's life.
landing-06-strip-profiles-body: Each client account is stored once, with its own membership and permissions.
landing-06-strip-dashboards-body: Pacing, execution and pending work summarised across every profile you run.
landing-06-strip-audit-body: Draft, approval and publish history stays attached to the post, not to a chat thread.
landing-06-tour-title-claim: One workflow for the whole week.
landing-06-tour-title-elaboration: Five surfaces, connected end to end.
landing-06-tour-description: Move from draft to publish with one timeline, one approval flow and one source of truth — five surfaces built for the same week's work.
landing-06-tour-calendar-title: Calendar that follows every brand in one week
landing-06-tour-calendar-description: A single timeline gives your team a shared view of planned and queued content, per profile and per region, without opening another tool.
landing-06-tour-calendar-image-alt: Month view of the calendar filtered to one region
landing-06-tour-composer-title: Build one draft, shape one version per audience
landing-06-tour-composer-description: Reuse copy and assets across profiles, then adapt only what changes for a channel or brand voice.
landing-06-tour-composer-image-alt: Composer open with per-channel variant tabs
landing-06-tour-approvals-title: No silent publishing, no guessing, no surprises
landing-06-tour-approvals-description: Approval and publish permissions are explicit at every step, so nobody can move a post live without the right sign-off.
landing-06-tour-approvals-image-alt: Approval queue with a post mid-review and its permissions visible
landing-06-tour-profiles-title: Profile-level controls for every client account
landing-06-tour-profiles-description: Store each account profile once, manage membership and permissions by profile, and keep context clean as teams grow.
landing-06-tour-dashboards-title: See what moved and what is still waiting
landing-06-tour-dashboards-description: Use a weekly view or a cross-profile summary to review pacing, execution and pending work at a glance.
